title: Want Your Story Published? Here's How
author: John Doe
summary: How to get your story published on JPT Beat
content: Have a story you think the JP Taravella community should know about? JPTBeat wants to hear from you!
Getting your story published is simple. Just email us at jptbeat@gmail.com with your story idea, article, photos, or any information you think is worth sharing.

After you contact us, we'll work with you to figure out how you'd like your story to be published. You can submit a finished article, send us the information and have us put the story together, or discuss another way to share it.
Want to remain anonymous? That's okay too. Just mention it when you contact us.
Whether it's something happening at school, an interesting student story, an event, or something you think deserves attention, send it our way!
